core.title: Give every acceptance embedded in a plan artifact an acceptance identity
core.given: A plan artifact outside the stack's never-scanned (vendored/generated) trees embeds one or more acceptances — new, edited, or untouched.
core.when: An embedded acceptance is encountered in a scanned plan artifact.
core.then: Every embedded acceptance is an object whose acceptance identity is a URN starting with the stack's acceptance URN scheme.
prefer: Give the acceptance an identity URN in the stack's acceptance URN shape, using the owning bounded slice of the product and a stable acceptance id.
avoid: Embedding an acceptance as a scalar or as an object without an acceptance identity.
An acceptance identity URN that uses any scheme other than the stack's acceptance URN scheme.
Leaving pre-existing embedded acceptances without an acceptance identity because you did not edit them.
unless: The plan artifact is in a vendored or generated tree — the stack's one never-scanned list; such files are out of scope.
core.why: Tests bind acceptances by their acceptance identity; an acceptance without it can never be proven.
evidence: The stack's plan-integrity check reports no embedded acceptance lacking an acceptance identity URN starting with the stack's acceptance URN scheme.
Every acceptance embedded in each scanned plan artifact is an object whose acceptance identity is a URN starting with the stack's acceptance URN scheme.
verification: Check: each acceptance embedded in a scanned plan artifact must be an object (not a scalar) whose acceptance identity is a URN starting with the stack's acceptance URN scheme; otherwise emit a finding. Applies to all embedded acceptances in scanned plan artifacts, not only changed ones.
Plan artifacts under the stack's never-scanned trees (profile roots.excluded) are skipped entirely; this check adds no further exclusions of its own.
Severity 3, disposition strict: the rule fails on every finding; there is no advisory mode.
The rule is held to the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention statement, strict disposition, a failing fixture, relationship edges.

values: embedded acceptance is not an object whose acceptance identity is a URN starting with the stack's acceptance URN scheme

fires: A plan artifact embeds an acceptance as a scalar instead of an object.
A plan artifact embeds an acceptance object with no acceptance identity.
An embedded acceptance's identity URN uses a scheme other than the stack's acceptance URN scheme.
An existing, untouched acceptance in a scanned plan artifact lacks an acceptance identity — it is still in scope.
doesNotFire: A plan artifact inside the stack's never-scanned (vendored/generated) trees.
Every acceptance embedded in the plan artifact is an object whose acceptance identity is a URN starting with the stack's acceptance URN scheme.
A plan artifact that embeds no acceptances.

neutralityNotes: The activation-fact vocabulary has no path/location fact, so the Bun path_glob exclusion fact is carried by core:unless and core:verification together with profile roots.excluded rather than a separate neutral activation fact. The location of the acceptance identity inside an embedded acceptance object (`identity.urn`) had no existing vocabulary key, so urn.grammar#embedded_acceptance_identity is proposed and also listed in profileRequirements. Severity 3 and strict disposition stay in core:verification per the notProfileKeys list; the validator id (planner_plan_integrity) and the ATDD-Bun package-gate framing remain bunOnly. The only mandate, everywhere in the core (then, evidence, verification, activation facts, fires, doesNotFire), is the acceptance URN scheme prefix; the full `acc:<capability>:<id>` shape stays a preference realized through urn.acceptance and is never a requirement.
